edits.old_string: It is a decision ask naming every open umbrella and every child in flight beneath it, at every depth. On the ruling it lands at once on its own branch, its diff operator-approved, through `crucible:finishing-a-development-branch`.
edits.new_string: It is a decision ask naming every open umbrella and every child in flight beneath it, at every depth; the ruling also decides whether the change takes a campaign (umbrellas.md § Review). On the ruling, or after its campaign where the ruling sets one, it lands at once on its own branch, its diff operator-approved, through `crucible:finishing-a-development-branch`.

note: Binding-change paragraph: the ruling also decides whether the change takes a campaign (umbrellas.md § Review), and landing waits for that campaign where one is ruled.
